records.name: acl_ipv4
records.command: iptables -S service_list; iptables -S SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT; iptables -S SCL_IP_DROP
records.output:
-N service_list
-A service_list -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A service_list -i br0 -j ACCEPT
-A service_list -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-N SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT
-A SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT -j SCL_IP_ACCEPT
-N SCL_IP_DROP

records.name: acl_ipv6
records.output:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N BIND_POLICY
-N IP6_BIND_POLICY_DEFAULT
-N SCL_IP_ACCEPT_V6
-N SCL_IP_DROP_V6
-N SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT_V6
-N dial_on_demand_active
-N flow_accel
-N ipport_filter
-N lan_filter
-N service_list
-N wan_filter
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT_V6
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_DROP_V6
-A INPUT -j service_list
-A FORWARD -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
-A FORWARD -j BIND_POLICY
-A FORWARD -j ipport_filter
-A FORWARD -j flow_accel
-A OUTPUT -j dial_on_demand_active
-A SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT_V6 -j SCL_IP_ACCEPT_V6
-A dial_on_demand_active -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j MARK --set-xmark 0x5354/0xffffffff
-A ipport_filter -i br0 -j lan_filter
-A ipport_filter -i br1 -j lan_filter
-A service_list -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A service_list -i br0 -j ACCEPT
-A service_list -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A wan_filter -m state --state INVALID,NEW,UNTRACKED -j DROP

records.name: namespace_features
records.command: for x in unshare nsenter; do command -v "$x"; done; ls -l /proc/self/ns/mnt /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null; if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E 'CONFIG_(NAMESPACES|MOUNT|OVERLAY|JFFS2|MTD_NAND|SQUASHFS)'; fi
